capabilities: Link a frontmatter property to an external folder
List folder contents in a sidebar pane
Watch folders for live file changes
Open files in their default apps
extras: Desktop only; each folder level caps at 500 entries; live updates rely on the OS file watcher and may miss changes on some network or cloud-sync folders. No network use, telemetry, account, or payment.
problem: Obsidian only shows files inside the vault, so notes referencing folders elsewhere on disk need each file linked by hand.
summary: Sidebar pane that lists the contents of an external folder linked from a note's frontmatter property, updating live and opening files in their default apps.
